title: Booking.com renews partnership with UEFA national team competitions
summary: The world's leading online travel booking platform will continue as the official accommodation and attractions partner, helping fans plan and experience their football journeys across UEFA competitions, including UEFA EURO 2028 and UEFA Women’s EURO 2029.
body_markdown:
UEFA has today announced the renewal and expansion of its partnership with Booking.com which will see the online travel booking platform continue as the official accommodation and attractions partner across various UEFA national team competitions, including the UEFA Nations League Finals 2027, European Qualifiers 2027–28, UEFA European Under-21 Championship 2027, UEFA EURO 2028 and UEFA Women’s EURO 2029.


This extends Booking.com’s long standing association with UEFA’s national team football following its partnership with UEFA EURO 2020 and 2024, and UEFA Women’s EURO 2022 and 2025.


As part of the renewed partnership, Booking.com will be integrated into the fan ticketing journey for UEFA Nations League Finals, UEFA EURO and UEFA Women’s EURO, helping supporters plan their tournament experience. This includes visibility during the ticket-purchase process and contributions to the Event Guide, offering travelling fans useful information as they prepare for the tournament.


Booking.com will also activate the partnership through two digital content-based sponsorship and engagement programmes, alongside a range of partnership rights, including on-site and LED visibility.
